translation: Lidong Wan (Lidong Pill, 黎洞丸) treats injuries from falls and blows, stagnant blood rushing to the heart, fainting and unconsciousness, and all kinds of nameless swellings and toxic swellings, with drowsiness and a desire to die, and similar conditions. Jing Niuhuang (bezoar), Bingpian (borneol), Shexiang (musk, two qian five fen each), Awei (asafoetida), Xionghuang (realgar, one liang each), Chuan Dahuang (rhubarb), Ercha (catechu), Tianzhuhuang (bamboo shavings), Sanqi (notoginseng), Guaer Xuejie (dragon's blood), Ruxiang (frankincense, oil removed), Moyao (myrrh, oil removed, two liang each), Tenghuang (gamboge, boiled in a water bath a dozen times, skim off the floating foam, mix with five qian of goat blood and dry in the sun; if goat blood is unavailable, substitute with lamb blood, two liang). Grind the above thirteen ingredients together into a fine powder, melt the Tenghuang and form into pills the size of a Gorgon fruit (芡實). If dry, add a little white honey, and seal the outside with a wax coating.
